messages.subject: Data Entry for breedR + Estimation of GCA and SCA
messages.subject_clean: Data Entry for breedR + Estimation of GCA and SCA
messages.body_plain:
I have some questions.
1. Regarding data input that has to do with families, must data be presented for each individual animal in the family or just a family mean would do?
e.g. if I have 56 families comprising 100 individuals each in a half dialel cross involving 4 males and 4 females  (including parental crosses).
2. I have compressed my data into a family data set as attached and I want to estimate main genetic effects of Heterosis, Line, GCA and SCA on the traits in the table. I would like to employ the model below:

Yhijk = μ + ah + p1ii + g2ib + g2jb + g3ic + g3jc + c2ij + c3ij + eijk

where Yhijk is the kth trait observation on the fish population from the ith sire and the jth dam in the hth line crossing (Inter-Hybrid, Intra-Hybrid or Purebred); μ is the overall mean; ah is the effect common to all progeny of the hth line crossing; p1ii is the effect common to all progeny of a mating between the ith strain of sire and the ith strain of dam; g2ib is the effect of general combining ability (gca) of the single strain of sire for inter-hybrids; g2jb is the effect of general combining ability of the jth strain of dam among inter-hybrids; g3ic is the effect of general combining ability (gca) of the ith strain of sire for intra-hybrids; g3jc is the effect of general combining ability of the jth strain of dam among intra-hybrids; c2ij is the effect of specific combining ability (sca) of the ijth cross (i = j); and eijk is the random error effect. Subscript 1 denotes that the effects were measured only among the progeny of purebred mating, subscript 2 denotes the effects among the progeny of the inter-hybrid mating and subscript 3 denotes effects among progeny of intra-hybrid mating.

I have looked at

https://github.com/famuvie/breedR/wiki/General-and-Specific-Combining-Abilities

I did understand the mating structure presented but was lost as to what the actual data input should be.

How do I write a code for this data in order to extract main effects as mentioned above and also Least square means attributable to these effects on the traits investigated?

Pardon me if I fail in making some points but with my little experience, I can only try as much.

I would really appreciate all the suggestions and knowledge in the forum.

messages.body_plain:
Dear Gabriel,

the issue with summarising the measurements into family means is that it neglects the variation within families (corresponding to the residual variance of your model).

So, either you model family means (by removing the specific combining ability term which will be taken into account automatically by the residuals) or you model individual observations, using the full dataset.

Hope it helps

ƒacu.-
